units.title: Standalone correspondence dependency foundation
scope: Human takeover and durable dispatch fencing

units.acceptanceCriteria: Standalone npm ci and npm run check pass on Node 24; adversarial tests verify each foundation control. CI, merge and live operational acceptance remain separate. No live transport is shipped.

evidence.localChecks: 30 tests, strict typecheck, declaration build, canonical registry validation, pinned contract hash and installed compiled ESM package smoke passed on Node 24.22.1
